visualCharacteristics.structure: icon + h3 + price + CTA + paragraph + bullets

contentPattern: 4 columns per row (one row per product). Cell 1: product icon image. Cell 2: H3 product name linked to product page / optional P tag (e.g. 'SaaS') / optional P Starts at $X / optional P price note / optional P link 'Get a Quote' / P link trial CTA (Start Trial | Download Trial = primary button) + link 'Quick View' (secondary button) / P trial note 'Fully functional for N days'. Cell 3: P intro + UL bullets. Cell 4: Deployment value 'SaaS' or 'Self-Hosted' (read by the filter, not rendered).
